text: APPROVE. The extracted helper returns null on exactly the conditions that were `continue` in the loop, in the same order, so behaviour is unchanged, and the loop is left with only a `for` and one `if`, which brings complexity well under 15. The build looks safe: `key` is a nullable string narrowed by the null check, so no new nullable warnings. I could not compile it here, so this rests on the diff alone.
